correctness.rationale: Reconstructed M_2(K_{2,2,2}) as degree-at-most-two subsets of the twelve precisely specified graph edges. Independent enumeration of all 4096 masks yielded 772 faces including empty, nonempty face vector (12,66,196,297,180,20), 377 disjoint matching pairs and an acyclic oriented Hasse graph (771 nodes, 2928 covers). Independent signed algebraic Morse projection recovered the claimed 6×10 integer attaching matrix: rank three with a unit 3×3 minor and all nonzero Smith factors one. The one-vertex CW model has six 3-cells, ten 4-cells and none in dimensions 1,2 or >=5. Thus π3 of its 3-skeleton is Z^6, the degree matrix fully controls 4-cell attachments, and integral homotopy reduces to three S3 plus seven S4. Separate mod-two boundary ranks (1,11,55,141,153,20) give reduced Betti (0,0,0,3,7,0); finite enumeration is exhaustive for this graph only.

value.rationale: The smallest maximally symmetric complete-tripartite octahedral example with a nontrivial higher matching threshold has a nonpure complex and genuine adjacent-dimensional integral sphere-wedge homotopy, stronger than a Betti or Euler-characteristic table. It supplies a concrete computable reference point for higher matching complexes beyond complete and bipartite families.
